title: LookFile
description:
A look as it is written, version 2: the typed sections and the typed map options. It has no page key: a look file is the style. Its
JSON is one mapping: these four keys and the sections' keys.

settings.description: the settings sources as given (a mapping, a list of them, or null)

access.description: the colour of each kind of restricted road

page.description: the page's defaults of the settings: the base map (never a key: a look is saved and published)

palettes.description: every palette that the look can name (a view's palette), by its name

active.description: the names of the profile and the palette

interaction.description: the road popup's default fields and the hover delay

base_map.description: the base map's part (a duckOSM map's mode, theme and path style); none with no base map

MapOptions.description: The map options. Each group has its default; a value that the profile gives is an `Option`: `None` is the profile's value.

boundary.description: GeoJSON: a geometry, a Feature or a FeatureCollection

Columns.description: The columns of the roads that the engine reads, by their names in the caller's table (the engine's own name when none is given).

directed.description: a two-way road as one edge (true) or as two

filter.description: the column that the filter panel lists, when it is not the class

cap.description: the cap of each road's ends

levels.description: the drawing positions, when the caller gives them (`Levels::Given` or `Levels::Stored`)

LevelColumns.description: The columns of the drawing positions (compute_levels' output columns).

Levels.description: Where the drawing positions come from.

oneOf.description:
the given columns, else the input's contract columns casing_level / fill_level (duckOSM's stored levels), else solved
(docs/reference/contract.md, "The drawing positions"; duckosm.read(levels="auto"))
the engine solves them (compute_levels(method="solve")), whatever the input has
the engine computes them with the tags rule
a duckOSM file's stored levels (`columns.levels`), solved for these edges: the engine checks that the edges are the same

DataColor.description: The colours of a map coloured by data (render_edges' data styler, colour table and colour options).

by.description: the column that gives each road its colour

style.description: a styler object (render_edges' `style`), as its JSON

table.description: a colour for each road, by the value of a column

options.description: the "Colour by" menu: one colouring for each option

active.description: the option shown first: its number or its name

Colors.description: Categorical colours: a colour for each value, or `"self"` (the value is the colour).

Cmap.description: A numeric ramp: a colour map's name, or a list of colours.

Color.description: "#rrggbb", "#rgb", a CSS colour name, or rgb(...), rgba(...), hsl(...), hsla(...)

Missing.description: In a colour option: a road with no value keeps the first option's fill (`base`) or takes the no-data colour (`self`).

ColorTable.description: A colour for each road: `colors` by the value of the column `key`.

ColorOption.description: One option of the "Colour by" menu: the keys of a data styler, all optional (none: the class style).

width.description: the width follows the value: (min, max) in px

Active.description: An option of the "Colour by" menu: its number or its name.

Width.description: The width of a road by data.

by.description: the column of the value (the data styler's column, when it is not given)

m_zoom.description: roads in metres: the zoom where a metre width is the class width

fill.description: false: the casing of each road, not its fill (the fill layers stay, for the clicks)

head_m.description: the length of a road's head in metres

casing_m.description: roads in metres: the casing in metres

casing_min_px.description: roads in metres: a casing is never thinner than this many pixels each side

offset_frac.description: two-way roads: each direction this part of the road width aside

width_frac.description: two-way roads: each direction this part of the road width

offset_zoom.description: two-way roads: the zoom where the two directions separate

minzoom.description: the first zoom of each class

ClassMinzoom.description: The first zoom of each class: the profile's table, none (every class at every zoom), or the profile's table with these changes.

Interaction.description: The clicks and the hover of the roads.

oneOf.description: the look's fields, in the docked panel

Tooltip.description: The hover tooltip of the roads.

control.description: the "Tunnels" box (a tool for choosing the tunnel look)

decks_3d.description: the raised 3D bridge decks, and the page opens tilted

Overlay.description: An overlay (rs.Overlay): a layer of the caller's features over or under the roads. `None`: the overlays settings' value.

color_column.description: the property with a colour for each feature (null: `color`)

width_m.description: a line's width in metres, exact from `min_zoom` on (in place of `width`)

dash.description: a line's dash pattern, in line widths

popup_window.description: false: a click selects it, with no floating popup

select.description: a click picks its road or the item itself (with `edge`)

edge.description: the features are items of the roads: drawn at their road's fill number

text.description: `kind: text`: the text and its paint

style.description: the name of a style of the theme's `overlays.styles`, whose fields fill what the overlay does not give

EdgeLink.description: The road of each feature of an overlay (rs.Overlay's edge_col and the columns that go with it).

column.description: the property with the id of the feature's road

order_column.description: the property with the feature's order (lower first; null: 0)

width_m_column.description: lines, simple mode: the property with each item's width in metres (else `width_m`)

offset_m_column.description: lines, simple mode: the property with each item's offset in metres (right of the line's direction; null: 0)

dash_column.description: lines, simple mode: the property with each item's dash pattern (null: `dash`)

column.description: the property that holds the text

Items.description: The road's own line items (lanes, lane lines, marks).

data.description: a FeatureCollection whose features name their road

popup.description: the fields that a clicked item shows (none: all its fields)

BaseMapOptions.description: A duckOSM map's base map: its modes and the start values of its layers.

modes.description: the mode columns of the road table (driving, walking, cycling, ...)

Output.description: The output: its name and its state.

live_data.description: the feature states that a page's dashboard colours the roads with (rs.setData)

export.description:
a style for an app with no road table (export_inline, export_style): the source `roads` with its pick and highlight layers, and
the export's arrows (fewer, one in the middle of each slot, and the slots' numbers). A map option because it changes stage 1: its
layers go through every pass, and they change the arrows layer and the controls (2026-10-25).

State.description: A style with its state baked in, or one that keeps MapLibre's global state (a page with the dashboard).

classes.description: each class: group, order, minzoom, width, casing_width, dash, no_casing, single_line, minor

width.description: the width of each group by zoom

casing_ratio.description: the casing width of each group: the fill width times this

twin_casing.description: "one" (one casing around a two-way road's two edges) or "each"

styles.description: each class of the palette as ClassStyler resolves it, plain and as a link, and the fallback

head_m.description: render's default head length in metres

width.description: a link's width: this part of its class's width

ClassStyles.description: Each class's style as ClassStyler resolves it: [plain, as a link] (fill, width, casing, casing_width, dash, opacity, casing_opacity).

RoadsModel.description:
road tables: the widths of each group by zoom, the zoom rate above the last stop, the casing ratio,
each class's group, the link classes, the zoom stops and each class's drawing order.

m.description: roads in metres: the casing in metres

min_px.description: roads in metres: a casing is never thinner than this many pixels each side

drop_below_px.description:
no casing piece (a bridge's keeps it) at a zoom where the whole casing line is narrower than this many px (0: always a casing).
Before `opacity`: the profile gives it, the palette gives `opacity`, and the theme keeps that order.

base_size.description: the size of the names by zoom: [[zoom, px], ...]

size.description: roads in metres: the names' size by zoom for every class

slots.description: the slots' tables: the class order and each class's width at zoom 20

slot_m.description: the length of one slot in metres (config annotations.slot_m)

Slots.description: The slots' tables (the names and the arrows): the class order, and each class's casing width at zoom 20 in px.

main.description: the classes of the main arrows

folium_hover.description: folium's hover colour (goes with folium, P7)

styles.description: an overlay's style by its name (the settings' `overlays.styles`)

BaseMapLook.description: mapstyle's base-map part: the layers of layers.yaml, the 3D buildings, the base map's style and its images.
